name: Strip Me Down: Jock
source:
After running practice Ashton the jock challenges you to a fun and flirty game of NSFW strip Rock Paper Scissors in this short and sexy gay minigame.

If he wins, you'll have to run another lap around the track... But if you win, he'll take off a piece of his clothing.

Keep on playing till he's got nothing left to show.

Play through the short story and progress by winning games of Rock Paper Scissors against Ashton, and maybe you'll be lucky enough to earn your happy ending...

Can you beat him?
